cues.text: Build a simple side table with Rectangle, Push/Pull, Make Object, Move, and Move Copy.
Choose Rectangle. Pick opposite corners to draw a tabletop sixty centimeters wide and deep.
Choose Push/Pull, select the face, and pull it upward. Type three for the tabletop thickness.
Select the tabletop geometry and choose Make Object. This keeps it separate from the legs.
With Move, lift the tabletop forty-two centimeters. Its upper surface is now forty-five high.
Draw a four-centimeter square below a corner. Pull it up forty-two centimeters, then make it an object.
Use Move Copy to make a second leg. Select both legs and copy them across to the far side.
The table is complete: one top and four linked legs. Save the project, then explore your own design.
